statistic: true-support minimum joint-covariance whitened SSE / selected entries over 27 nuisance members; eligible failures retained as infinity
method: fuelprint.science.rank.CalibrationRunner using FullChainCalibrationRunner; FP-COMPAT-3/4; world FP-WORLD-3; response GasChannel;dt_s=0.05;SO2_line_delay_s=2.261946710584651,chamber_t90_s=8.0,sensor_t90_s=60.0;CO2_line_delay_s=3.769911184307752,chamber_t90_s=8.0,sensor_t90_s=30.0
seeds: FPCAL: java.util.SplittableRandom 0x465043414C000000 + i, i=0..226; never the SC1-SC3 seeds
domain: 6 singles and 15 pairs uniformly; wind U(240,300)deg/U(2,5)m/s; per-source SO2 log-uniform0.25..50g/s, CO2/SO2 log-uniform500..2000; fixed detector snapshot300s plus subsequent two-gas capture
generator: actual PuffWorld20Hz + SensorField20Hz + TeachDetector1Hz + TeachCaptureRules.windows; constant emissions from0; measured backgrounds retain plume; no inverse-kernel-generated observations
route_limit: Calibration inlet moves in a straight line at <=3m/s from(0,0,2) to(0,100,35) or(120,100,35); real field acceleration/obstacles/body-to-inlet offset are not sampled by this calibration domain
coverage_limit: Conditional on the declared NO_SIGNAL gate and this generator only. SC1 CO2/SO2 ratio25 is outside the declared500..2000 domain. Raw-fit coverage does not imply final-survivor coverage after NOT_NEEDED.
